title: FormConfig
description: FormConfig Contract v2.0 — Shape for form integration in Admin and SharedReport surfaces. Forms are served by the Worker and stored in D1.

signupUrl.description: Published form URL (Worker QR landing page, e.g. /forms/:eventId?type=register)

qrB64.description: QR code as base64-encoded PNG data URI (if generated)

totalResponses.description: Total response count from D1 form submissions
